description: Save, rewrite, or delete one of your reusable skills. A skill has no trigger; a saved task that runs on a schedule is a routine. Cursor-managed skills can't be changed.

body.description: Required on write. The recipe, in markdown.

description.description: Required on write: one line a reader uses to decide it applies ("use this when …").

id.description: An existing skill's id. Required for delete. On write, pass it only to rewrite that skill; omit it to create one (its id is made from the name).

scope.description: Omit for the default. "user": the owner's skill library, which all of their bots share. "bot": this bot alone. A call is refused where that scope is not available.
